payload.text: The capture window has two real bounds and the contract states whether both can be met. VC'S EARLIER FRAMING WAS BACKWARDS AND IS CORRECTED HERE: ambient MITIGATES rather than compounds, because ease is capped at max_ease so the 1.4 multiplier never bites at the cap while dwell's 1.5 always does. Measured -- dwell 2500 ease 3000 gives a window of MINUS 500ms at default pace (the transition outlasts the slide) and PLUS 750ms under ambient. Default pace is the broken case, at any configured ease at or above 2500. vc computed only the ambient case and described it comparatively against a default case never computed: a population of one, reported as a comparison. Once AC-3.11's compile-time cap and refusal land, no config reaching the runtime can have ease >= dwell and this bound is closed at the source. AND THE ROW'S POPULATION IS THE HARNESS, NOT ONE COMMAND: measured 2026-09-09 by snorkeltoast, both bounds are computed and lo >= hi returns None in control and compare, with selftest covering a legal ease-3000 / dwell-2500 windowless config and both sides of the narrowest window (dwell 1301 gives (1100,1100); dwell 1300 gives None), so FLOORS.md's "0 windowless" is a RESULT and not a tautology. BUT cmd_capture and cmd_redproof pass no budget_for and capture at a flat 4000ms, computing no window at all -- two of four commands honour the bounds. Harmless on this reel, whose window is 1100..4520 so 4000 sits inside it, which is why redproof's numbers stand; on a legal dwell-2500 reel the same path photographs the NEXT slide while labelling it this one. FIXED AT snorkeltoast 28b4127 AND VERIFIED BY vc AT THE SOURCE, with one leg still unverified. The derivation is now ONE windows_for() at showreel-harness:381 with three consumers -- cmd_capture, cmd_control and cmd_redproof -- where control had it inline and capture and redproof had nothing; and capture() now DIES with "capture() was called with no per-slide budget" rather than defaulting. snorkeltoast's reasoning is the right one and is worth keeping: fixing it at the two call sites would have left the default sitting there for the next caller, and A DEFAULT THAT IS WRONG ON SOME INPUTS CANNOT BE FIXED BY REMEMBERING TO OVERRIDE IT. Re-measured against 008 at the corrected budgets, 1100ms on all 22 slides against 4000ms before: slide 6 red at 0.999752 unchanged, 13 at 0.001500 and 14 at 0.002196 at their control floors exactly -- the injury figure holding at a budget nearly four times earlier in the dwell, which is what reduced motion predicts and is now measured rather than assumed. THE UNVERIFIED LEG IS cmd_compare, which is not among windows_for's three call sites; vc has not established where it takes its budgets from, and grading a row on three of four commands after the row was minted about two of four would repeat the error in a smaller size. Discharged when every capturing command's window source is established, cmd_compare included.
